summary: Lando Norris won the São Paulo Grand Prix Sprint from P2 on the grid, 0.6s ahead of Oscar Piastri, with Charles Leclerc completing the podium.
Sergio Perez made the biggest climb, from P13 to P8.
Oliver Bearman had a day to forget, dropping from P10 to P14.
The race was neutralised by 1 virtual safety car.
Rain fell at some point during the race.
Max Verstappen leads the championship by 45 points over Lando Norris.
